messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: kickoff & draft next steps (Syncwell Health)

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the discovery today — really helpful to understand Syncwell's goals for chat-enabled patient support and the key constraints around latency and data residency. Per our conversation, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to help align on milestones, owners, and a target close date.

High-level options (please pick the one that best reflects your timeline):

1) Aggressive (recommended if internal approvals are quick) — 6-week pilot
   - Week 0: MAP sign-off & kickoff; credentials + environment access
   - Week 1–3: Integration, test traffic, quality tuning (Redwood + Syncwell)
   - Week 4: Pilot validation (SLA smoke tests, latency/cost metrics)
   - Week 5: Exec review & rollout plan
   - Week 6: Pilot close / decision to scale

2) Conservative — 10-week POC (recommended if procurement/Security need extra time)
   - Weeks 0–2: MAP sign-off, legal & procurement, security questionnaire
   - Weeks 3–6: Integration & tuning
   - Weeks 7–8: Pilot validation, user feedback loop
   - Weeks 9–10: Exec review & decision

Draft MAP (attached): Syncwell_MAP_v1.xlsx — milestones, dependencies we called out during the call, and suggested owners.

Initial asks from our side:
- Please confirm which timeline (Aggressive or Conservative) you prefer.
- Confirm primary stakeholders who should be listed on the MAP (we included the contacts below as a starting point).
- Any additional dependencies we should track (e.g., network approvals, procurement SLA, SOC2 evidence request).

Suggested stakeholders we captured from the call:
- Sophie Turner (Pilot owner / Product)
- Martin Lee (CTO) — technical sponsor
- Tara Singh (CISO) — security approver
- Angela Cruz (Cloud Ops) — infra/permissions

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm timeline & stakeholders by Monday 11/09 (so we can lock the MAP and schedule kickoff).
- Once confirmed, we’ll send a 30–45 minute MAP kickoff calendar invite with owners and milestones.

I’m cc’ing Aditya (AE) and Dylan (SE) — they’ll own implementation coordination and technical onboarding.

Attachments: Syncwell_MAP_v1.xlsx; discovery-notes-20261105.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to aligning the team and getting the pilot moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

- Confirmed stakeholders (please add to the MAP):
  - Sophie Turner (Product / Pilot Owner)
  - Martin Lee (CTO / Technical Sponsor)
  - Tara Singh (CISO / Security Approver)
  - Angela Cruz (Cloud Ops Lead)
  - Mark Benson (Procurement) — procurement@syncwellhealth.com

- Dependencies to call out explicitly:
  - SOC2 evidence & questionnaire turnaround (we’ll need Redwood SOC2 report and a short Q&A)
  - Network/Firewall rules and IP allowlist for pilot infra
  - Procurement review window (we typically allow a 2–3 week review for initial contracts)

Availability: next week I’m available Tue/Wed 10–12 PT and Thu 1–4 PT for the MAP kickoff meeting. Martin is traveling Monday but can join Tue afternoon.

If you can update the MAP with the Conservative timeline and owners, we’ll aim to confirm by 11/09.

Thanks — Sophie
